maddeler.e:
يقت (form I)
# يَقُتُّ (yaquttu) /ja.qut.tu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of قَتَّ (qatta)
# يُقَتُّ (yuqattu) /ju.qat.tu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of قَتَّ (qatta)
# يَقُتَّ (yaqutta) /ja.qut.ta/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of قَتَّ (qatta)
# يُقَتَّ (yuqatta) /ju.qat.ta/: third-person masc
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
